mechanism_narrative: A rising FEDFUNDS rate predicts negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to higher discount rates eroding future equity value expectations.
failure_condition: Over 60-day rolling window, 20-day forward returns are non-negative when FEDFUNDS rises, or IC > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 5%, the S&P 500 60-day forward return turns negative as investors anticipate tighter credit conditions.
failure_condition: In regimes where FEDFUNDS > 5%, 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in PAYEMS (labor market strength) coincides with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as strong hiring boosts corporate optimism.
failure_condition: Over 100 instances where PAYEMS rises > 2% but 20-day forward returns are negative or flat (IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO (industrial production) below 100 suggests supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns as market anticipates soft demand.
failure_condition: Over 30 days with INDPRO < 100, 5-day forward returns are not negative (IC > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (consumer demand) and HOUST (housing starts) predict positive S&P 500 20-day returns via dual demand expansion.
failure_condition: In 50+ instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST rise > 2% but 20-day returns are negative (IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falling below 3% signals labor market weakness, associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as investors expect slower wage growth.
failure_condition: Over 40 instances where UNRATE < 3% but 60-day forward returns are non-negative (p-value > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS < 700M indicates persistent demand weakness, resulting in negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 100 months with RSAFS < 700M but 20-day forward returns are positive (IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO and GDPC1 both fall sequentially for two consecutive months, S&P 60-day forward returns turn positive as market anticipates supply-side normalization.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls 2% then GDPC1 falls 2% in next month
failure_condition: Over 20 such trigger events but 60-day forward returns remain negative (IC < -0.2).
